content.description: Diagnostic connector selector switch showing ON and OFF positions with 'Check' label and arrow pointing to switch

items: Turn the ignition switch and OD switch ON. Do not start the engine.

content.description: Illustration showing location of DG terminal in engine compartment with arrow pointing to terminal

items: Using a service wire, short the DG terminal and body ground.

content.description: Dashboard gauge cluster showing speedometer, tachometer, and indicator lights including OD OFF light location

items: Read the diagnostic code as indicated by the number of flashes of the "OD OFF light".

content.description: Timing diagram showing normal operation pattern with light blinking once every 0.25 seconds, with ON and OFF states marked

content.text: (a) If the system is operating normally (no malfunction), the light will blink once every 0.25 seconds.

content.description: Timing diagram showing malfunction code pattern with varying blink intervals: 0.5 seconds for first digit, 1.5 seconds pause, 2.5 seconds for next code, and 4.5 seconds repeat interval

content.text: (b) In event of a malfunction, the light will blink once every 0.5 seconds. The first number of blinks will equal the first digit of a two digit diagnostic code. After a 1.5 seconds pause, the 2nd number of blinks will equal the 2nd number of a two digit diagnostic code. If there are two or more codes, there will be a 2.5 seconds pause between each.
